# Ideal Postcodes

Ideal Postcodes provides UK and international address search, postcode lookup, address cleansing, and contact validation APIs.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/idealpostcodes/.

## Actions

- **Find Address Suggestions** (read-only): Return ranked address suggestions for a partial address without resolving them.
- **Find Place Suggestions** (read-only): Return ranked country, city, and administrative-area suggestions without resolving them.
- **Get Address by Identifier** (read-only): Retrieve a UK address by UDPRN or UMPRN.
- **Lookup Postcode** (read-only): Return addresses at a UK postcode, or an Irish Eircode when enabled.
- **Resolve Address Suggestion** (read-only): Resolve an address suggestion ID to a complete GBR or USA address.
- **Resolve Place** (read-only): Resolve a place suggestion ID to full geography and coordinates.
- **Search Addresses** (read-only): Search complete UK address records by text, filters, or coordinates.
- **Validate Address** (read-only): Match and standardize a GBR or USA address with confidence details.
- **Validate Contact** (read-only): Validate an email address or international phone number using an optional paid dataset enabled on the connected Ideal Postcodes API key.
